rationale: Windows IPv6 binding is locally disabled. Enabling only ms_tcpip6 on the active physical adapter is a reversible test for native ISP IPv6, which could provide direct globally routable connectivity without VPN/proxy and without altering IPv4.
rollback: Disable-NetAdapterBinding -Name 'Ethernet 3' -ComponentID ms_tcpip6 if IPv4 regresses or IPv6 state is unhealthy.
authority: Microsoft NetAdapter Enable-NetAdapterBinding semantics reviewed; component-specific binding only.
